cover: A fill-in budget for an AI feature

slides.title: Requests per month
slides.body: Write down expected usage and a higher volume that'd make you nervous. Count every model call a single click makes.

slides.title: Tokens in, tokens out
slides.body: Instructions, documents, conversation and question all go in. A token is about four characters of English.

slides.title: Price per million tokens
slides.body: Input and output for the model you tested. Output costs more, and the gap between models is bigger still.

slides.title: Multiply it out
slides.body: Example: 3,000 tokens in, 500 out, 10,000 drafts a month. About $110 on Sonnet 5.5, about $5.50 on Haiku 5.5.

slides.title: Subtract what you can
slides.body: Cache the repeated opening block. Batch work that can wait, at about half price. Trim the context you send.

slides.title: Limits and an owner
slides.body: A spending alert, a budget per customer, and a named person who acts when the limit is reached.
